attributes.subject: Can't access dashboard
attributes.details: Customer cannot sign in to the dashboard; sees a Session Expired error on every attempt. Clearing cookies did not help.

messages.author: Jane Smith
messages.body: Hi, I can't access the dashboard since this morning. I get a "Session Expired" error every time I try to log in. I've tried clearing cookies but it didn't help.

messages.author: Mike Tan
messages.body: Hi Jane, thanks for reaching out. Let me check your account status and get back to you shortly.

messages.author: System
messages.body: First response met — 15m of a 2h target.

messages.author: Mike Tan
messages.body: Checked the auth logs — no failed logins at all, which points at SSO rather than the password. Escalating to L2 if she confirms she is on SSO.

messages.author: Jane Smith
messages.body: Yes, we use Okta for sign-in. Nothing changed on our side as far as I know.

messages.author: Mike Tan
messages.body: Thanks Jane — that confirms it. Okta's clock is drifting past the five-minute tolerance, which expires the SSO assertion in transit. I'm passing this to our identity specialists now; they'll contact your Okta admin with the exact setting to change.

messages.author: System
messages.body: Status changed from Pending to On Hold.

messages.author: System
messages.body: Status changed from On Hold to Open — the clock is running again.

messages.author: System
messages.body: Status changed from Open to Cancelled — the clock is stopped.

messages.author: System
messages.body: Status changed from Cancelled to Open — the clock is running again.

cardInfo.name: #1234 Can't access dashboard
cardInfo.summary: VIP customer locked out of the dashboard; suspected SSO clock skew.
